title: Comparative impact evals for INT4/INT8 AWQ vs GPTQ and adaptive alert gates
text:
Comparative impact evals for INT4/INT8 AWQ vs GPTQ and adaptive alert gates

description:
Goal: Build a repeatable, automated evaluation harness that compares INT4 and INT8 quantization profiles produced by AWQ and GPTQ backends and wires those comparisons into an adaptive thresholding alert system. The harness should produce deterministic quality deltas (EM/F1/ROUGE/LL) and a calibrated risk score for each model+profile combination so the Console can block bad rollouts and the runtime can select fallback variants under pressure.

Context: Recent private-customer regressions surfaced only after a canary rollout where AWQ-int4 reduced exact-match on constrained QA by more than 2.5% compared to float. We need a pipeline that couples a broad set of eval suites with workload-aware thresholds and a short-circuit gating mechanism for deploys and runtime routing. This ticket scopes the eval harness and the adaptive gate algorithm (not the Console UI polish).

Non-goals: UI redesigns, full A/B experiment analysis infrastructure, new dataset collection process (we will reuse existing eval sets and one customer prompt package).


acceptance_criteria:
Automated harness runs nightly and produces a CSV summary of: profile, backend (AWQ/GPTQ), quant bits (4/8), delta vs float baseline for metrics on each eval suite
Calibrated risk score computed per profile that maps to one of: allow, warn, block
Rollout gate function implemented as a webhook that returns allow/warn/block and is exercised by the canary job
Integration test: simulated canary run that triggers a block for at least one known-bad AWQ-int4 profile on the conserved-QA dataset
Documentation: runbook describing how to add a new eval suite and how thresholds are tuned

tasks:
Design metric set and failure modes (EM, F1, ROUGE-L, per-token log-prob delta, hallucination rate)
Implement harness runner that spins profiles through AWQ and GPTQ toolchains and records outputs
Wire existing eval suites: conserved-QA, MMLU-subset, HellaSwag, TruthfulQA, and customer-prompt-pack
Create risk scoring function that combines metric deltas and workload weightings
Implement adaptive threshold calculator that ingests historical deltas to set warn/block cutoffs
Expose webhook endpoint for the rollout gate and unit tests for decision logic
Add alerting rule and Grafana dashboard panels for regression heatmap and risk counts
Write runbook and a short demo script for Solutions/SEs

metrics:
Primary metric: delta exact-match (EM) vs float baseline on conserved-QA
Secondary metrics: delta F1, delta ROUGE-L, mean per-token log-prob delta
Operational: proportion of profiles classified as block/warn/allow, nightly harness runtime, end-to-end canary latency
Economic: estimated token-cost delta per 1M tokens served when using quantized profile

evaluation_plan:
Nightly runs across all supported model families (Llama2-like, Falcon-like) with representative sequence lengths. For each profile we compute per-dataset deltas against a pre-computed float baseline. Use bootstrap sampling to attach 95% confidence intervals. Produce a single risk score by weighting conserved-QA more heavily for customers using retrieval-augmented QA. Flag any profile with delta-EM worse than adaptive threshold or with hallucination rate above 0.5% as 'block'.

threshold_policy:
Start with conservative default: block if delta-EM <= -1.5% on conserved-QA OR hallucination rate increases >0.3% absolute. Warn if delta-EM between -0.5% and -1.5% OR per-token log-prob delta worse than -0.6. Adaptive recalibration: the system will recompute thresholds weekly using the 90th percentile of historical safe-profile deltas per model family and adjust by a safety margin of 0.5%. Any change to thresholds requires review by SRE and ML lead before a release into Console gating.

rollout_plan:
Phase 1: internal harness validation and simulated canaries (this ticket). Phase 2: soft canary integration with Dedicated canaries (1% traffic) for select customers, 24h observation. Phase 3: enable webhook gating in Console for 'autoblock' mode behind a feature flag. Manual override available in Console and API.

risks_and_mitigations:
Risk: False positives blocking safe profiles for low-resource models. Mitigation: conservative initial thresholds and manual review override.
Risk: Evaluation runtime blowup as we scale to many profiles. Mitigation: incremental scheduling, prioritized profile sweeps, and use of cache artifacts for compiled kernels.
Risk: AWQ/GPTQ implementation drift producing non-deterministic outputs. Mitigation: pin quant toolchain versions in the harness and compute checksum of compiled artifacts.
Risk: Mis-weighted customer impact. Mitigation: allow per-customer weights and add a customer-impact tag to profiles during evaluation.

progress_updates:
2025-02-13: Kickoff meeting with ML, SRE, and Console. Agreed to reuse conserved-QA and customer-pack for initial scoring.
2025-02-15: Prototype runner implemented for Llama2-family with AWQ-int4; baseline float runs completed for conserved-QA.
2025-02-18: Initial risk scorer v0.1 merged to feature branch, bootstrap CI jobs producing CSV outputs. Observed one AWQ-int4 profile with -2.8% EM on conserved-QA.
2025-02-21: Webhook prototype implemented and smoke-tested via simulated canary. Preparing runbook draft for review.
